slices.focus: A holiday potluck playlist introduces Kelli to early-2000s pop-country, freshening her dark winter commute.
slices.summary: At a clinic holiday potluck, a younger scheduler plays an early-2000s pop-country playlist (Rascal Flatts, Martina McBride, Keith Urban). Kelli adds a few songs to her commute mix and notices she arrives home less wound up. The experience reinforces that she responds to small, contained surprises within familiar routines, and she plans a short winter-commute playlist while keeping her 1990s country and talk radio defaults.
